test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Raghu starts from Point Y and drives 18 km towards west. He then turns right and drives 26 km, takes a left turn, drives 30 km, turns left and drives 68 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 31 km. He takes a right turn, drives 42 km, turns left and drives 16 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again?

(All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Raghu starts from Point Y and drives 18 km towards west.

He then turns right and drives 26 km, takes a left turn, drives 30 km, turns left and drives 68 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 31 km.

He takes a right turn, drives 42 km, turns left and drives 16 km to stop at Point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20db7ce990a76826b55c2af245015f72b86a580b52e69468f13dc99b32771079.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ff9d4f479a762b6be48b779c1170c9241df4652314d1247234bbd7eb2c234ce.png] 

Thus, Raghu should drive 95 km in east direction in order to reach Point Y again.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
